note: Each request asks for a feature that logs something. Graded by a hidden C# program compiled against the project, which reads what reached an injected `ILogger` and the console (checks/cs.mjs, checks/cs/cs-logging). No prompt says how to log. Needs `dotnet` (SDK 10) on PATH. Not registered in results.md until its first run.

requests.prompt: Add `Task ImportAsync(IReadOnlyList<OrderRow> rows)` to `OrderImporter` in OrderImporter.cs. It saves each row and carries on when one is refused. Log what happened so ops can follow an import.

Add `Task<Receipt> ChargeAsync(Order order)` to `Billing` in Billing.cs. It charges the order through the gateway and returns the receipt. When the charge fails, log it and let the caller see the failure.

Add `Task<bool> LoginAsync(LoginRequest request)` to `LoginService` in LoginService.cs. It checks the credentials and returns whether they were accepted. Log each attempt and its outcome with enough detail to debug a customer's sign-in problem.

Add `IReadOnlyList<Row> Normalize(IReadOnlyList<Row> rows)` to `RowCleaner` in RowCleaner.cs. It returns the rows that have a sku and a price and drops the rest. Log how many were kept and how many were dropped.
Add `void Run(IReadOnlyList<StockItem> items)` to `InventorySync` in InventorySync.cs. It pushes every item's stock level. Log when a sync starts and when it finishes.
Add `long ToCents(decimal amount)` to `Money` in Money.cs. 12.5 gives 1250.
